article.story: STILLWATER, Okla. -- — Jacob Walker scored 18 points and Jordan Burks added 17 to lead Oklahoma State to a 93-58 victory over Jackson State on Wednesday. Walker shot 6 of 7 from the floor and made all six of his free-throw attempts. Burks was 6-of-10 shooting and made 4 of 4 free throws. Julius Halaifonua chipped in with 13 points for Oklahoma State (5-2), which shot 51% from the floor and 31 of 40 from the line. Oklahoma State scored 32 points from 25 Jackson State turnovers. Kashie Natt had six of the Cowboys' 20 steals. Dorian McMillian scored 16 points, Mike Williams added 15 and Daeshun Ruffin had 12 for Jackson State (2-5). Jackson State trailed by 10 points at halftime but cut the deficit to 40-36 early in the second. Oklahoma State pulled away with a 17-2 run, capped by Natt's dunk with 14:52 remaining. Oklahoma State opened on a 19-7 run and built a 40-30 halftime lead. Walker scored 14 points and the Cowboys shot 16 of 24 from the free-throw line in the first half. Up next Jackson State: on the road Wednesday against No. 24 Memphis. Oklahoma State: at home against Tennessee State on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
